notes: Wattle Notes 0.1.8 developer alpha. Adds notebook and folder deletion with confirmation and full local recovery in History & trash. Preserves nested pages, attachments, empty folders and unindexed files. Saves pending edits first, refuses unsafe paths and restore collisions, and syncs page/attachment deletions and restorations. Retains the responsive sync and accurate transfer progress fixes. Google sign-in is built in; users can connect without creating or importing an OAuth client. Keeps existing notebook configuration and notes. Mostly vibe coded with AI assistance. Mac build remains unsigned by Apple and not notarized.
